title: MySQL: a stopped gateway's Binlog Dump thread stays 5 to 25 minutes

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: MySQL 8.4.13, six gateways on one instance, serverless

symptom: The Binlog Dump thread stayed in SHOW PROCESSLIST for 5 to 25 minutes after the pipeline showed IDLE and the update CANCELED. It closed after KILL on the source.
cause: Not established. It may be MySQL's net_write_timeout.
effect: The source keeps a connection to a stopped gateway.
fix: Wait for it to close, or KILL it on the source, before a measured run.
notes: Stopped through the pipeline API only. net_write_timeout and wait_timeout weren't recorded.
